About the author

Kate Fox is a retired newspaper writer and editor. She has written more than ten novels, five screenplays, and hundreds — maybe thousands — of newspaper and magazine articles.
Kate writes and publishes fiction under several pen names through her own imprint, Nineteen Cents Press. Her stories are set in the American West — a little mystery, a little history, a little magic, and always some humor. Follow her to be the first to know about freebies and new releases.
She writes mainstream and literary fiction as Kay Hartford, cozy mysteries as Kendall Casey, and paranormal women's fiction as Amanda Hartford.
